statement: Standing water stream runs a short walk north-northeast of the shelter field; raw water can be consumed or poured into a container from the flowing shallow water
Glass jars lie near the stream: a 3 L glass jar about 22 tiles southeast and 0.5 L glass jars about 30 tiles east of the start spot, plus field stones, sticks, long sticks, tinder and a syringe
Clean water can be crafted from 1 untreated water using a boiling tool or a nearby fire; batches of up to 12 are possible and 12 portions take about 51 minutes, 1 portion about 5 minutes
A small fire was lit on the pavement in front of the shelter door using burnt small cardboard boxes as fuel; it serves as the nearby fire for boiling water
The player knows the digging stick recipe and crafted digging sticks (digging 2 tool) from memory
A clay pot needs 5 lumps of clay, a nearby fire or kiln and a water item; fabrication 2 and missing Pottery proficiency give about 57% minor failure and it cannot be crafted in the dark
Clay is obtained through the Extract Clay or mound-of-clay constructions, which need a tool with digging 2 or more
Items on the shelter floor near the door include 2 planks, nut and bolts (3), scrap metal (17) and 3 splintered wood
Two portions of clean water were boiled over the pavement fire and poured into the 0.5 L glass jar; the 3 L glass jar was filled with 12 portions of untreated stream water
After starting the 12-portion clean-water batch at the fire the game stopped presenting new frames, and the batch's completion is not established
